intro.zh: 涵蓋蘇格拉底式家教、AI 素養與學術誠信、回饋與學習分析：檢查你知道哪些環節需要教師把關。80 分通過；本測驗為課程自編練習，非 Anthropic 官方認證。
intro.en: Covers Socratic tutoring, AI literacy and academic integrity, and feedback and learning analytics: do you know where the teacher must stay in charge? Pass at 80. A course-made practice quiz, not an official Anthropic certification.

q.zh: 學生問「為什麼天空是藍的？」。想讓 Claude 當家教、培養學生自己思考，哪種做法最合適？
q.en: A student asks 'why is the sky blue?'. To have Claude tutor and build the student's own thinking, which approach fits best?

opts.zh: 請 Claude 直接給出完整答案，讓學生抄下來之後拿去複習
opts.en: Have Claude give the full answer directly for the student to copy down and review later

opts.zh: 一律禁止學生使用，改成只能看課本與講義的內容
opts.en: Ban student use entirely and allow only textbook and handout content

opts.zh: 請 Claude 用提問引導，例如反問夕陽為什麼是紅的，讓學生自己接起線索
opts.en: Ask Claude to guide with questions, such as why sunsets are red, so the student connects the clues

opts.zh: 請 Claude 一次列出所有相關知識，由學生自行挑選
opts.en: Have Claude list all related knowledge at once for the student to pick from

why.zh: 引導式提問讓學生自己把線索接起來；何時給答案、何時引導，由教師決定。
why.en: Guiding questions let students connect the clues themselves; the teacher decides when to give answers and when to guide.

q.zh: PLC 課學生說「馬達不會自保持，為什麼？」。要讓 Claude 當助教，提示詞比較適合怎麼寫？
q.en: A PLC student says 'my motor won't latch, why?'. How should the prompt for Claude as a teaching assistant be written?

opts.zh: 要求一次給出完整梯形圖與逐行解說
opts.en: Ask for the full ladder diagram with a line-by-line explanation at once

opts.zh: 說明助教角色、不直接給答案、一次只問一個問題、學生卡住才給一級提示
opts.en: State the assistant role, no direct answers, one question at a time, and a first-level hint only when the student is stuck

opts.zh: 要求 Claude 直接把程式修好，並自動下載到 PLC 執行
opts.en: Ask Claude to fix the program itself and automatically download it to the PLC

opts.zh: 只寫「幫我看看」，其他由 Claude 自行判斷
opts.en: Write only 'take a look' and leave everything else to Claude

why.zh: 明確限定角色與提問節奏，Claude 才會帶學生一步步找出問題；下載程式到設備由人員確認。
why.en: Defining the role and pacing makes Claude lead students step by step; downloading programs to equipment is confirmed by people.

q.zh: 學生看到風機齒輪箱溫度警報就說「換感測器吧」。教師請 Claude 協助時，較合適的做法是？
q.en: A student sees a turbine gearbox temperature alarm and says 'just replace the sensor'. What is a better way to use Claude?

opts.zh: 請 Claude 直接宣布是冷卻系統故障並建議立即停機
opts.en: Have Claude declare a cooling fault and recommend immediate shutdown

opts.zh: 同意學生的說法，直接開立工單去更換該感測器
opts.en: Agree with the student and directly open a work order to swap that sensor

opts.zh: 不進行討論，改要求學生把整張警報代碼表背下來
opts.en: Skip discussion and require students to memorize the whole alarm code table

opts.zh: 先請 Claude 反問溫度何時上升、風速功率有無變化、鄰近測點如何，讓學生自己推理
opts.en: Have Claude ask when the temperature rose, whether wind and power changed, and what neighboring sensors show, so the student reasons it out

why.zh: 先診斷迷思再用反例修正；停機與檢修決定一律由現場人員確認。
why.en: Diagnose the misconception first, then correct it with counterexamples; shutdown and repair decisions are always confirmed by field staff.

q.zh: 下列哪一個課堂 AI 使用政策寫法最清楚、最有助於學生遵守？
q.en: Which classroom AI policy is clearest and most helpful for students to follow?

opts.zh: 分成可用、限用並標示、不可用三級，寫進課程大綱並舉例
opts.en: Three levels (allowed, limited with disclosure, not allowed), written in the syllabus with examples

opts.zh: 只寫一句「請同學自行判斷是否適合使用 AI」，不舉例說明
opts.en: One line, 'students judge for themselves whether AI is appropriate', with no examples

opts.zh: 全校統一同一條規則，各課程與作業都不得自行調整
opts.en: One school-wide rule that no course or assignment may adjust

opts.zh: 課程中不事先說明界線，等發現違規之後再個案處理
opts.en: Give no boundaries during the course and handle violations case by case once found

why.zh: 規則事先寫清楚比事後抓違規有效，且各課程、作業可以不同；內容由教師與學校制定。
why.en: Clear rules up front work better than catching violations later, and they can differ by course and assignment; teachers and schools set the content.

q.zh: 智慧自動化專題報告要求學生揭露 AI 使用。下列哪一份揭露最具體、可供教師判斷？
q.en: A smart-automation project report requires AI disclosure. Which disclosure is specific enough for the teacher to judge?

opts.zh: 工具、用途、採用了什麼、修改了什麼，例如「用來整理輸出入點表格式，已對照圖面並刪除錯誤地址」
opts.en: Tool, purpose, what was kept and what was changed, e.g. 'used for I/O table layout; checked against drawings and removed wrong addresses'

opts.zh: 「本報告在整理與撰寫過程中有使用 AI 工具協助」
opts.en: 'AI tools were used to help organize and write this report'

opts.zh: 「部分內容參考網路資料與 AI 的建議，已自行整合完成」
opts.en: 'Some content draws on online sources and AI suggestions, integrated by me'

opts.zh: 不另外寫揭露聲明，只把完成的成品依期限交出
opts.en: Write no disclosure statement and just hand in the finished work by the deadline

why.zh: 具體揭露才能看出學生自己的貢獻；是否構成違規由教師依政策判斷。
why.en: Specific disclosure shows the student's own contribution; whether it is a violation is judged by the teacher under the policy.

q.zh: 實習報告草稿寫「機組可利用率約 98%」，但原始 SCADA 匯出為 96.4%。最合適的處理是？
q.en: An internship report draft says 'availability about 98%', but the raw SCADA export shows 96.4%. What is the best handling?

opts.zh: 回頭核對原始資料的數字、單位與來源，修正後再署名
opts.en: Check numbers, units and sources against the raw data, correct, then sign

opts.zh: Claude 整理出來的內容應該是對的，直接交出去
opts.en: Claude compiled it so it should be right; hand it in directly

opts.zh: 把責任推給 AI，只在報告中註明「由 AI 產生」就算交代
opts.en: Blame the AI; simply note 'generated by AI' and call that accountability

opts.zh: 把數字改成看起來更漂亮的整數 100%，讓報告更好看
opts.en: Change it to a tidier-looking 100% so the report looks better

why.zh: AI 可能把典型值寫成實際值；報告署名的是作者，責任也在作者。
why.en: AI may write a typical value as if it were actual; the report carries the author's name, and so does the responsibility.

q.zh: 四十份 PLC 實作報告要給回饋。下列哪種流程最合適？
q.en: Forty PLC lab reports need feedback. Which workflow is most appropriate?

opts.zh: 讓 Claude 評分後直接把成績與回饋寄給學生
opts.en: Let Claude grade and send scores and feedback straight to students

opts.zh: 不提供規準與範例，請 Claude 依整體感覺逐份評分
opts.en: Provide no rubric or sample and ask Claude to grade each report by overall feel

opts.zh: 把評分規準與範例回饋交給 Claude 逐份產生草稿，教師逐份確認、修改後才發回
opts.en: Give Claude the rubric and a sample comment to draft each one; the teacher checks and edits each before returning it

opts.zh: 只挑前五份看，其餘沿用同一則回饋
opts.en: Read only the first five and reuse one comment for the rest

why.zh: 草稿加快初稿，評分與最終回饋仍由教師把關。
why.en: Drafts speed up the first pass; grading and final feedback remain the teacher's responsibility.

q.zh: 老師要寫訊息給家長說明學生近況，並請 Claude 擬稿。哪種做法最妥當？
q.en: A teacher wants Claude to draft a message to a parent about a student's progress. Which practice is most appropriate?

opts.zh: 以「學生 A」等代號去識別化後再貼上，擬稿經老師確認並自行發送
opts.en: Use a code like 'Student A' to de-identify, then have the teacher review and send it personally

opts.zh: 貼上學生完整姓名與整份成績單，這樣才能寫得精準
opts.en: Paste the student's full name and whole grade sheet so the message is accurate

opts.zh: 請 Claude 擬完稿後直接代替老師把訊息寄給家長
opts.en: Have Claude draft it and then send it to the parent on the teacher's behalf

opts.zh: 擬稿不必再檢查內容，只要語氣友善就可以寄出
opts.en: Skip checking the draft; a friendly tone is enough to send it

why.zh: 學生姓名與成績等個資不貼進對話；訊息由老師確認並自行發送。
why.en: Do not paste student names or grades into the chat; the teacher confirms and sends the message.
